title: Approval binding
description: The binding text basalt_meta.hold_action builds, in the text rules of CONTRACT.md, Stores, Text rules. The WebAuthn challenge is sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Clients parse it for display and never re-serialise it. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals.

kind.description: Reverts (M3) use kind REVERT in their own binding, api/mcp/revert/revert-binding.schema.json.
The store's kind (CONTRACT.md, Stores). A page uses it as a label only.

name.description: The name the store gives what the agent is bound to: current_database() in Postgres. For display.

agent.description: The agent that holds the write, agent:<name> with <name> its name in engine.json; never the store's login (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Agent names).

request.description: The held request, by family (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Request families). A page refuses to offer signing for a kind it has no view for.

statement.description: The statement as the agent sent it.

params.description: Values bound to $1, $2, ... as the agent sent them.

assignedFields.description: The fields the request writes (in Postgres the columns of the target table the statement assigns); their new values are bound, and the page marks them.

rowsHash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the preview lines joined by a newline.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC with microseconds, 24 hours after the hold.
